_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). Agio Z3 is the US-market Agio-branded (Peg Perego) three-wheel all-terrain stroller; older gen, largely superseded by the Z4/Ypsi and thinly stocked at US retail. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Agio Z3 All-Terrain Stroller (by Peg Perego)

clekListed.clekRow: Peg Perego Agio Z3 — Agio car seat adapter for Z3 stroller (IKCS0019NA)

specs._weightNote: ~10 kg / 22.05 lb (Paltux lists 22.05 lb; Strollberry lists 10 kg).
specs._dimsNote: Converted from Strollberry metric spec: open 113.5 x 63 x 107 cm (L x W x H); folded 92 x 63 x 38 cm. Consistent with Paltux's listed values (reordered).

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (with compatible infant car seat or bassinet); seat use ~6 mo+

safety.standards: US-market stroller; complies with ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 (specific rated limits not separately published by Agio)
safety.certifications: Not separately published by Agio/Peg Perego on the US product page
safety.notes: 5-point harness; multi-position reclining backrest; wheels lock/swivel.

specs.tires: three high-performance wide-tread rubber-coated wheels on 8 ball bearings; swivel/lockable front

notes: Older-generation Agio (Peg Perego US brand) three-wheel all-terrain stroller; ~22 lb, one-hand self-standing book fold. Forward-facing only (non-reversible seat), distinguishing it from the newer four-wheel reversible Z4/Ypsi. Confirmed on Clek's official Liing/Liingo list; Clek Liing attaches via the Agio Z3 adapter IKCS0019NA (adapter-ikcs0019na). Now thinly stocked at US retail (many listings 404/discontinued); best live deep-linked price $349.99 (Paltux, sale, reg $399). Basket capacity and JPMA certification not separately published — left null.
